verdict.rationale: Kong's Dev Portal is documented as letting users "browse and search API documentation, try API operations, and manage their own credentials" and publishes OpenAPI/AsyncAPI-based docs, which matches an interactive reference with runnable calls. However, this is only first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and Kong's own docs site OpenAPI endpoint probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the 'try it' experience, explicit mention of runnable code examples (vs. generic 'try API operations'), and confirmation the reference works outside first-party claims.
